newsitem.title: UK: BFI up six, Pacific improving, Atlantic unclear.
newsitem.headline: BFI up six, Pacific improving, Atlantic unclear.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose six points on Friday to 1,023 points.
Brokers said that rates for Panamaxes in the Pacific continued to improve slowly but the situation was less clear in the Atlantic.

They said EMC fixed Hanjin tonnage for 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Japan for Nov 15/25 at $20.25 basis no combination but Halla were reported to have fixed Chinese tonnage for first half November at only $19.50 no combination.
Caper rates remained very depressed in all areas.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX reflected the gradually changing sentiment in the underlying market and was up between 10 and 12 points in the active months where 259 lots were traded.
